outlook.statement: The Company continued to deliver a robust financial performance in the fiscal year 2025-2026 too, demonstrating significant growth in profitability and operational efficiency.
Company plans to fully switch to sustainable and renewable sources of power/energy such as Solar and PNG energy in addition to current power sources during the current financial year.
Commercial production through PVC films and paper tube manufacturing machine expected to commence in the forthcoming quarter.

Overall growth rate of the market size is more than 10% annually. Encouraged by the results the Company has established another factory at its industrial plot at Sikandrabad Industrial Area... The units have been in commercial production and barring unforeseen circumstances it is expected that your company well in the current financial year.

After commencement of commercial production at Unit II of the company, demand for products of the company have gone up and are likely to go up further during the current financial year and hence the profitability of the company is expected to improve.
Availability of imported finished goods at cheaper rate in the market due to dumping by the foreign companies may adversely affect the profitability of the company.

PVC resin is the most important raw material for the company. Demand for PVC resin in the country has been increasing every year. However, the supply is still not adequate to meet the demand. Further, for certain grade of resin, there are few manufacturers in the country. Hence any disruption in the supply of resin and/or any other raw material may affect the operations of the company adversely.
